app.taxi_text: Calls a taxi. It arrives when it arrives.
app.kamera_text: Start photo mode and snap away.
app.kamera_gesperrt: You need the camera from POW! first.

fahrdienst.storniert: Cancelled. The driver sighs in slow motion.
fahrdienst.verpasst: And off it went. The next car costs full price again.
fahrdienst.belegt_titel: A car is already on its way
fahrdienst.belegt: {dienst} is driving for you right now. Two cars would be silly.
fahrdienst.rettung: Gooby is out of energy — the taxi will still take him home.

taxi.pitch: Ten coins, honest work, a vanilla air freshener. Waiting time: a few minutes, just like real life.
taxi.unterwegs: Your taxi is on its way
taxi.da: The taxi is at the door!
taxi.bestellt: Taxi called. The driver is already indicating.
taxi.fahrt: Hopped in! Off we go home.

guber.pitch: Twenty-five coins. In return the car is here in under two minutes and the driver says "very well".
guber.da: Your Guber is waiting. The driver holds the door.
guber.bestellt: Very well. The car has been ordered.
guber.fahrt: "There you are." It smells of fresh leather.

kamera.text: Starts photo mode over the current scene. Viewfinder, shutter, done.
kamera.leer: No pictures yet. The sensor is quite excited.

foto.hinweis: Line up the viewfinder and shoot.
foto.fehler: The picture refused to hit the disk.

freunde.fehlt: The friends screen is unavailable right now.

goobypal.text: Send a friend a few coins. No strings attached. Mostly.
goobypal.offline: Offline — GoobyPal needs a connection. And friends.
goobypal.verlauf_leer: No coins have traveled yet. Your history is waiting for its first good deed.
